final_answer: The scientific consensus is that there is no credible evidence linking the MMR vaccine to autism. Multiple large-scale studies, meta-analyses, and reviews by organizations like the **CDC**, **WHO**, and **Cochrane Library** have consistently found no association. The original 1998 study suggesting a link was retracted due to flawed methodology and ethical violations. Current evidence overwhelmingly supports vaccine safety. For detailed references, consult peer-reviewed journals or the [Cochrane Review on MMR and autism](https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/).
